say:1:1432502001:1.text: My husband's secret treasure fund—hidden right under my nose!
say:1:1432502001:1.source_cn: 我丈夫背着我偷偷藏起来的小金库！
say:1:1432502001:1.male: My husband's secret treasure fund—hidden right under my nose!
say:1:1432502001:1.female: My husband's secret treasure fund—hidden right under my nose!

say:2:1432502002:1.text: I swear, I'll dig three feet down if that's what it takes!
say:2:1432502002:1.source_cn: 掘地三尺我也要找出来！
say:2:1432502002:1.male: I swear, I'll dig three feet down if that's what it takes!
say:2:1432502002:1.female: I swear, I'll dig three feet down if that's what it takes!

say:3:1432502003:1.text: Argh! Still no sign of it! Alright, that's it. Tonight, when he sneaks off to hide the money, I'm catching him red-handed!
say:3:1432502003:1.source_cn: 啊啊！怎么都找不到！算了，等他晚上藏钱的时候，我要抓个现行！

say:5:1432502004:1.source_cn: 多一个人就多一分抓到他的可能性……

say:5:1432502004:1.female: The more eyes, the better our chances.

say:6:1432502005:1.text: Then meet me at the <style="highlight">crossroads</style> after <style="highlight">dark</style>. Keep a lookout for any <style="highlight">suspicious-looking dwarves</style> hanging around!

say:7:1432502006:1.text: He's got red hair. Thanks a lot.
say:7:1432502006:1.source_cn: 那家伙是个红头发的大个子，麻烦你了。
say:7:1432502006:1.male: He's got red hair. Thanks a lot.
say:7:1432502006:1.female: He's got red hair. Thanks a lot.

choice:4:1:2.text: I can help you keep watch.
choice:4:1:2.male: I can help you keep watch.
choice:4:1:2.female: I can help you keep watch.

say:0:1432503001:0.text: A little coin, a little drink...

say:0:1432505001:0.text: Heh heh... come to me, my shiny secret stash...
say:0:1432505001:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我的小金库，让我来摸摸金币！

say:0:1432506001:0.source_cn: 趁他还在这里，回去找雷温娜吧。

say:1:1432507001:1.text: So that's where he hid it... Don't tell me he spent it on booze again?
say:1:1432507001:1.source_cn: 原来在那啊……他是不是又拿钱去喝酒了？
